_note: Clinical-to-atlas spatial mapping. The ONLY place where clinical display names (transmitter subtype labels, drug target strings, pathway strings) are joined to registry IDs and atlas geometry. UI code must never hardcode these joins. Statuses: mapped = registry record for that exact subtype/target; family = registry record for the same family (sites may differ; note says how); none = no record (note says why); off-atlas = real anatomy outside this model. Regenerated never by hand-check: scripts/coverage-map.mjs validates every ID, label and marker here.
